conviction_note: Event confirmed for 2026-10-29 at the company's habitual 15:30 slot, nothing pre-released; street FY ordinary profit (15,232m) sits 5% above the unchanged plan (14,500m) and last year's H1 print carried a raise (+12%), but Q1 this year was weaker with front-loaded one-offs, so the forecast decision is a genuine coin with fat tails: findings sum +0.5 (small, mostly inference), scaled number +0.1 from p_up 51 on a 5.0% abs move.
bar: FY27/3 company plan sales 240,000m / OP 15,000m / ordinary 14,500m / NP 10,000m / DPS 80 (interim 40), unchanged at Q1 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260728500512.pdf); analyst consensus OP 15,400m / ordinary 15,232m (up from 15,040m a week earlier) on kabuyoho (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=9551, 2026-10-28). Only one consensus source, so findings resting on it are capped small. No H1 plan is published.

No skew exists; priced_lean_pct -0.41 (margin overhang -0.58, run-up +0.17).

findings.finding: The street is above the company plan going into H1: kabuyoho consensus FY27/3 ordinary profit 15,232m (+5.0% vs plan 14,500m, raised from 15,040m within the last week) and OP 15,400m (+2.7% vs 15,000m); a raise at this print (as happened at last year's H1, 2025-10-27, OP 11,500->13,000 and DPS 56->70) would be well received, a hold is a mild letdown against that number.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-27 H1 print with FY upward revision + dividend raise: gapped up, +11.96% (baseline; https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9551&b=n202510280339). 2024-10-30 H1 print with no revision and a wider H1 loss: -0.56%. 2026-04-24 new-year guide (OP 15,000): -9.67%.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus number is public, so the gap itself is priced as an expectation; what is not priced is the decision. If the market were sure of a raise the stock would not be -3.4% over 20 days and sitting below the 10-26 bounce level at 2,990 with PER 13.1; if it were sure of a hold, SBI's 2,800->4,000 target raise would not have lifted it. The binary is open, hence the wide range and small central size.
findings.independence: Last year's revision pattern from a different document (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9551&b=k202510270021). Against it: no revision at the 2024-10-30 H1 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9551&nmode=0&date=20241000) and Q1 this year weaker YoY. One consensus source only.

findings.finding: Q1 FY27/3 OP loss (-910m vs -603m) was driven by items the company calls front-loaded (不具合対策処理 in environmental engineering and 前倒し処理 of unprofitable Schwing Bioset projects) and described as 概ね計画通り, with backlog a record 425.9bn yen (+19.9% YoY) and overseas backlog +33.9%; a cleaner Q2 margin against last year's Q2 OP of 1,748m is the likelier direction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-07-25 Q1 loss narrower than expected: +7.81% (baseline); 2026-07-29 Q1 loss wider: -4.96% (baseline). The name reacts to quarterly margin quality, but the H1 reaction is dominated by the forecast decision.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the Q1 deck is public and SBI's 10-23 note cites the overseas legacy clean-up as finished. What is not in the price is the Q2 number itself; Metawater publishes no monthly orders or sales, so there is no 月次 that pre-reveals the quarter. Sized toward 0 because the company said Q1 was on plan, i.e. inside its own guide.
findings.independence: SBI Securities note (via MINKABU on kabutan, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9551&b=n202610260339, 2026-10-26) says the overseas legacy-loss processing is complete. Different source, same direction, but a sell-side read rather than a document.

findings.finding: Yen is running well weaker than the plan rate (plan 150 JPY/$, Q1 actual 157.0, ~157.9 on 2026-10-29), a small translation tailwind on the 66bn overseas segment (7% margin) and a source of FX gains below OP (Q1 carried a 134m FX gain).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to FX at this name; overseas is ~28% of sales.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission and public FX; roughly 3bn of sales and ~0.2bn of OP on a full year, about 1-2% of OP. Mostly priced and tiny; filed because it is sourced and bears on the plan's ordinary-profit line.
findings.independence: Current USD/JPY 157.87 from the kabutan quote header (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=9551, 2026-10-29).

findings.finding: Margin longs built into the print after SBI's target raise: 75.8k -> 97.4k shares in the week to 10/23 (ratio 25.3x -> 14.5x as sells also rose), a leveraged retail long that sells on an unchanged guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Public and already in the baseline's margin_overhang component (-0.58), so largely priced; the build is only about one day of turnover. Kept small.
findings.independence: Baseline margin_ratio 14.54 (same scrape family). None independent.
